Primeape

Fighting

Kanto · Generation 1

Primeape is a Fighting-type Pig Monkey Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 32 kg. It evolves from Mankey and into Annihilape. Its highest base stat is Attack (105), with a base stat total of 455.
